acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks about not being able to admit when he's wrong, as well as other traits he's not proud of, but can't seem to change.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Sam Slaven is an Iraq War veteran who came home from the War plagued by feelings of hate and anger toward Muslims. TAL producer Lisa Pollak tells the story of the unusual action Sam took to change himself, and the Muslim students who helped him do it.
acts.title: And So We Meet Again

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Sometimes the inner voice telling us to do the wrong thing actually sounds like a voice. TAL producer Nancy Updike talks to people about the voices in their heads that persuade them to go astray.
acts.title: Vox Diaboli

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Some people battle inner demons, but contributor David Ellis Dickerson went one step further. David tells the story of the time he took on an actual demon in his college classroom.
acts.title: The Devil Wears Birkenstocks
